name: ktkit
description: A spec-driven development toolkit for Claude Code: fourteen skills covering the path from a feature request or a bug report to a reviewed spec, an executed change, and a durable record of both. chain runs that path as one closed loop -- it resolves the open questions each phase raises by dispatching resolver subagents, records every answer in an append-only ledger the later phases read instead of re-deriving, and stops only for what could not be settled and would be expensive to get wrong. docs-review audits a document set with a team of agents that run concurrently and challenge each other's findings. spec-recon adds the axis a document reviewer cannot reach — it measures source code, binary artifacts and version-control state, and gates every claim that something is missing behind an agent that tries to refute it. analyze-feat, rca, feat-req-specs and bug-fix-specs turn a request into a reviewed specification; feat-req-execute and bug-fix-execute carry it out; ccompact and ccontinue keep a long pipeline alive across compaction; escalation-ladder resolves unknowns from the repository before asking you; confirm-with-me gates a single irreversible step; translate-file translates a file without touching its identifiers. Every skill writes to one fixed artifact root, runs a preflight that proves a capability with a real request instead of trusting a tool's own error message, and works whether or not speckit is installed.
